after.zh: 光照让 R、G、B 一起变大变小，三者的比例却不变。r = R ÷ (R + G + B) 只看颜色、不看明暗，是一种色度。HSV、Lab 这些颜色空间也是同一个想法：把「什么颜色」和「多亮」分开放。
after.en: Lighting scales R, G and B together, but their proportions stay the same. r = R ÷ (R + G + B) sees the colour and not the brightness: it is a chromaticity. Colour spaces such as HSV and Lab follow the same idea: they keep "which colour" apart from "how bright".

t.zh: 找红灯、分开天空和草地，都要靠颜色。可一个红苹果在阴影里，R 很小；一张白纸在阳光下，R 却很大。
t.en: Finding red lights, telling sky from grass: these rely on colour. Yet a red apple in the shade has a small R, while a sheet of white paper in the sun has a big one.

t.zh: 这一关的输入是同一个场景的 R、G、B 三张图，光照有明有暗。
t.en: This level's inputs are the R, G and B images of one scene, with light and shade across it.

caption.zh: 第一组测试：窗边的苹果

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：标出红色的东西，亮处的、阴影里的都要；白纸、黄花不算。要想的问题：光照变强变弱，R、G、B 三个数之间有什么不变？
t.en: Your task in this level: mark the red things, in light and in shade alike; white paper and yellow flowers do not count. Something to think about: as the light gets stronger or weaker, what stays the same among R, G and B?

brief.zh: 三张输入是同一个场景的 R、G、B。标出红色的东西：亮处的、阴影里的都要；白纸、黄花不算。
brief.en: The three inputs are the R, G and B of one scene. Mark the red things, in the light and in the shade alike; white paper and yellow flowers do not count.

hint.zh: 阴影里的红苹果，R 并不大；阳光下的白纸，R 却很大。光照把三个数一起放大缩小，什么量不受它影响？
hint.en: A red apple in the shade has a small R; white paper in the sun has a big one. Lighting scales all three numbers together, so what stays the same?
